messages:
nina (new hire): hey all, first day! quick Q about Notion templates: our team wants to fork the engineering design doc template and add a couple of sections. what's the recommended pattern so we don't create a dozen slightly different canonical copies?

harper (DevEx): welcome nina! :wave: don't make a new canonical template. create a team-specific "derived template" in /Engineering/Templates/Derived and link back to the canonical template under Company Home/Templates. That way the canonical stays clean and teams can add team-specific sections.

nina (new hire): nice. when i copied the canonical template into our Derived folder, it's showing a "Page locked by workspace admin" banner. any idea?

sam (Docs Owner): hey @nina, a few templates are locked when they include automation or HR-linked variables. Locking prevents accidental deletion. I can unlock a team copy for editing if the page is moved under your team space and the team is in the "derived-editors" Notion group.

nina (new hire): how do we request that group membership?

ops-bot: To request Notion group access, open https://redwood.internal/access-requests and select "Notion group membership". Include your team name and page URL. People Ops and Docs approve during business hours.

mike (eng lead): also heads up: prefer we add new sections as collapsible toggles and keep the header structure intact so the canonical TOC links still work. If you need new page properties, use: Owner, Team, DocType, Status, TemplateBranch (e.g., team:v1).

nina (new hire): got it. any guidance on automated reminders or Slack syncs in team-derived templates? our onboarding checklist uses a Slack reminder when StartDate is set.

harper (DevEx): automation is allowed but gated. Team-derived templates can include placeholders for automation, but enabling live automations (Slack reminders, HR syncs) requires a ticket to infra for the webhook auth. Use the automation placeholder block and then file https://redwood.internal/infra-automation with the page URL.

sam (Docs Owner): small policy note: don't store secrets in automation blocks (tokens, API keys). Use the platform secret manager and reference via an internal integration.

nina (new hire): thanks  last question  when we move a team draft to the KB (Knowledge Base), is there a review step or PR-like workflow?

mike (eng lead): yes, please follow the docs PR flow: set Status to "Ready for Review", add @docs-review in the comments, and set TemplateBranch to the release tag you want. Docs team will do a quick edit pass and then mark it Published.

sam (Docs Owner): we also have a checkbox checklist in the KB Review template: links verified, commands in fenced code blocks, rollback steps included, escalation contacts listed. If everything is green we move it to /Knowledge Base/Engineering/Published and keep a redirect from the team page.

nina (new hire): perfect, thanks everyone! i'll create a derived copy under /Engineering/Templates/Derived/infra-team and ping ops-bot for the group. :raised_hands:

ops-bot: Reminder: to request page ownership transfer or enable automations, submit a ticket with the Notion page URL and desired owner/integration.
